faqs.a: Your order is being worked on and sent out as soon as possible! Your food should arrive hot and fresh any minute now!
faqs.q: What is the status of my order?

faqs.a: All pickups after 1am, including for uber drivers, or "Too good to go pick up" - please use the intercom by the front doors.
faqs.q: I'm here to pick up my order after 1am.

faqs.a: A Too good to go order must be picked up during the associated time frame with the order. You must come into the store with the app installed and ready to swipe for pick up on the app in the allotted time frame.
faqs.q: When can I pick up my "too good to go" orders?

faqs.a: No, you do not! Simply bring it back to the restaurant and we'll take care of the rest.
faqs.q: Do I need to wash the tray before returning?

faqs.a: Everything on our menu is halal and we do not carry any pork products in our store.
faqs.q: Do you serve halal options?

faqs.a: Yes! We have a gluten-free pizza.
faqs.q: Do you offer gluten-free options?

faqs.a: Yes. I recommend using our vegan cheese on your pizzas or our famous vegan lasagna!
faqs.q: Do you offer vegan options?

faqs.a: Yes! Some popular options include our vegetable lasagna, our ravioli, fettuccini, manicotti, spaghetti napoli, and our breads. We also have an option for veggie pizzas.
faqs.q: Do you offer vegetarian options?

faqs.a: Yes the gravy is completely vegetarian
faqs.q: Is your poutine vegetarian?

faqs.a: On Mondays, we offer a medium one topping pizza for only $8.99. Our Tuesday special is a large one topping pizza for $11.99. We Offer specials for Wednesday, Thursday and Friday available Online Only.
faqs.q: Do you have daily specials?

faqs.a: Yes many of our salads support adding chicken.
faqs.q: Do you have a chicken salad?

faqs.a: We offer regular wings, they are Baked and then fried to serve and they are not breaded.
faqs.q: What kinds of wings do you have?

faqs.a: We can only add regular chicken as a topping, shawarma chicken is a specialty pizza.
faqs.q: What kinds of chicken toppings do you have?

faqs.a: No unfortunately we don't offer stuffed crust
faqs.q: Do you have stuffed crust?

faqs.a: We offer a fresh variety of slices, but they cannot be ordered over the phone. Please place an order online or in person.
faqs.q: Can I order pizza by the slice?

faqs.a: No, Unfortunately we no longer offer the super party challenge. Sorry about that
faqs.q: Do You Have a Super Party Pizza Challenge?

faqs.a: Delivery is free on orders over $30 within our standard delivery area, which reaches about 8 kilometres. Outside that area free delivery doesn't apply and the fee varies with distance - give me your address and I can check it for you.
faqs.q: What is the delivery fee?

faqs.a: Yes but deliveries outside of milton must be place on our website. Want me to send you a link to order online?
faqs.q: Do you deliver outside of Milton?

faqs.a: We only accept scheduled orders through our website. Would you like me to send you a link?
faqs.q: Can I schedule an order?

faqs.a: We only accept scheduled orders through our website. Would you like me to send you a link?
faqs.q: Can I place an order for tomorrow night?

faqs.a: We do! Catering orders MUST be placed at least 48 hours in advance through our website. Would you like the link?
faqs.q: Do you offer catering?

faqs.a: We are located in Downtown Milton at 17 Commercial Street, just south of the car wash.
faqs.q: Where are you located?

faqs.a: Yes, our parking is located at the rear of our building, there is a driveway between us and the car wash which takes you to the back parking.
faqs.q: Do you have parking?

faqs.a: Yes, we are open EVERY day of the year, we do not close for any holidays and operate regular hours.
faqs.q: Are you open for the holidays?

faqs.a: Yes we will be open on Christmas
faqs.q: Are you open on Christmas?

faqs.a: We opened in 2014! We have never changed owners and we serve our authentic food using our original recipes which have never changed!
faqs.q: When was Luigi's founded?

faqs.a: No, We are currently only operating our Flagship Milton Location
faqs.q: Are there other locations?

faqs.a: No, unfortunately we do not have any outdoor seating or pet friendly areas.
faqs.q: Is there outdoor seating or any pet friendly areas?

faqs.a: If you ordered through Ubereats, please reach out to them directly for assistance.
faqs.q: Can I ask about my UberEats order?

faqs.a: Sorry the team is focused on preparing delicious meals for our customers and cannot answer calls. Please direct any questions, concerns or requests to us via the contact us form on our website. I'll send you a link.
faqs.q: Can I speak to a human/manager/team member?
